entities.name: Esper
entities.description: One of five Shards of Alara, a blue-aligned magocracy ruled by sphinxes and filled with etherium.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane whose five shards merge after the Conflux.

entities.name: Sphinxes of Esper
entities.description: Ruling sphinxes whose foresight transformed Esper into a tightly controlled magocracy.

entities.name: Ethersworn
entities.description: Humans, vedalken and sphinxes dedicated to infusing all life with etherium, a quest called the Noble Work.

entities.name: Ignoble Flesh
entities.description: Splinter group of Ethersworn who believe the body should be fully replaced with etherium.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: Blue-skinned mages who control much of Esper, regulate tides and hoard etherium.

entities.name: Vronos
entities.description: A planeswalker contacted by the Ethersworn who agreed to planeswalk in a controlled setting in exchange for knowledge.

entities.name: Breya
entities.description: A young artificer who rediscovered sangrite in Jund and forged the first new etherium in centuries.

entities.name: Tiln
entities.description: A human hermit stormcaller living in a tower in Cloudheath.

entities.name: Kemuel
entities.description: A sphinx who guards the Riddle Gate beyond the Crystal Labyrinth.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker born in Tidehollow who took over the Infinite Consortium and the Academy.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Faced Tezzeret in the Grand Laboratory.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Phyrexian leader whose Machine Legion targeted Alara.

entities.name: Machine Legion
entities.description: Elesh Norn's Phyrexian army.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: The event when red and green mana flooded Esper and the shards merged.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion that targeted Alara.

entities.name: Etherium
entities.description: Aether-infused filigree metal omnipresent on Esper.

entities.name: Vectis
entities.description: Esper's largest human fortification.

entities.name: Tidehollow
entities.description: Subterranean slums and birthplace of Tezzeret.

entities.name: Sanctum Arcanum
entities.description: Vedalken temple fortress in the clouds that houses the Filigree Texts.

entities.name: Infinite Consortium
entities.description: Organization Tezzeret took over.

entities.name: Riddle Gate
entities.description: A planar portal guarded by the sphinx Kemuel.

events.summary: The Ethersworn contact Vronos, who agrees to planeswalk in a controlled setting in exchange for knowledge.
events.quote: In exchange for knowledge, Vronos agreed to planeswalk in a controlled setting for the Ethersworn for a while.

events.summary: At the Conflux, red and green mana flood Esper and its hegemony begins to fall apart.
events.quote: When the Conflux happened, red and green mana flooded into Esper.

events.summary: Esper's borders merge with Bant and Grixis into the new Alara.
events.quote: Esper's borders continued to smash into Bant and Grixis until it became part of the new Alara.

events.summary: Dragons regularly bombard Esper's fortified cities.
events.quote: none more so than the dragons, who regularly bombard the fortified cities of Esper.

events.summary: Breya rediscovers sangrite in Jund and forges the first new etherium in centuries.
events.quote: The young artificer Breya rediscovered Sangrite in Jund , forging the first new etherium in centuries.

events.summary: Elesh Norn's Machine Legion strikes Alara.
events.quote: Alara as was targeted by Elesh Norn 's Machine Legion as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion with a simultaneous strike on Bant, Esper, and Jund.

events.summary: Tezzeret takes over the Academy, killing everyone present.
events.quote: After Tezzeret 's takeover of the Infinite Consortium , he returned to the Academy and killed everyone present, including the Hiersearch and every single member of the Arcane Council and Inner Circle.

relations.quote: Under the foresight of Esper's ruling sphinxes , the plane has transformed from wilderness to a tightly-controlled magocracy.
The Riddle Gate - a planar portal guarded by Kemuel .
Tidehollow - the backwater birthplace of Tezzeret .
Alara as was targeted by Elesh Norn 's Machine Legion
